look_here_first: Look for an unwinged perennial stem with mostly opposite coarse leaves and a few very large yellow daisy-like heads. The opposite leaves and lack of stem wings separate it from many other Verbesina.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis — UT Plant Resources Center specimen index. Kerr — Kerr Wildlife Management Area vascular flora. Comal — first collection/type-area documentation from New Braunfels, Comal County.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Hays Purola record is explicitly introduced and is not counted as native evidence.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Asteraceae composite heads with yellow ray florets surrounding many yellow disc florets.
best_field_traits: large solitary or few yellow heads
large ray florets around raised yellow disc
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with Verbesina virginica, V. lindheimeri is shorter with large yellow heads and mostly opposite leaves; frostweed is taller, white-flowered, and often has winged stems.
